newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end down, seen tethered.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end down, seen tethered.

text.p: Austrian shares end with moderate losses on Thursday and traders see the market trading within a tight range ahead of the expiry of June futures contracts next Friday.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips is seen trading between 1,290 and 1,310 points.
The ATX index fell 4.48 points, or 0.34 percent, to 1,296.08 with 12 shares falling, eight gaining and one unchanged by the close.
"Business only came in towards the end, giving the ATX a bit of a boost," said a trader, adding the activity came from the futures market rather than from investors.
High-grade steelmaker Boehler led decliners, falling 1.47 percent to 921 schillings, while Lenzing was the top performer, adding on 2.29 percent to 737.5.
Traders said selling in Boehler was triggered after it broke through technical support at 940.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index lost 1.13 points, or 0.24 percent, at 476.31.
The June ATX future fell six points to 1,299 on volume of 982.
